description: This is a FastAPI backend server implementation for a Jira Dashboard application. It provides endpoints for health check, user authentication, fetching user projects, and retrieving specific project details. The file sets up API routes, dependency injection, logging, CORS middleware, and handles exceptions. It uses data models and services related to Jira integration.

classes.name: JiraService
classes.description: A service class responsible for interacting with Jira's API for authentication and project management.

classes.name: JiraCredentials
classes.description: Data model representing Jira user credentials including email, API token, and domain.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: Response model for authentication results, including success status and user info.

classes.name: ProjectsResponse
classes.description: Response model listing Jira projects accessible to the user.

classes.name: ProjectDetailsResponse
classes.description: Response model for detailed project information.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify if the API is running.

methods.name: AuthResponse authenticate_jira_user( credentials: JiraCredentials, jira_service: JiraService = Depends(get_jira_service) )
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user with Jira credentials.

methods.name: ProjectsResponse get_user_projects( credentials: JiraCredentials, jira_service: JiraService = Depends(get_jira_service) )
methods.description: Endpoint to fetch all Jira projects accessible to the authenticated user.

methods.name: ProjectDetailsResponse get_project_details( project_key: str, credentials: JiraCredentials, jira_service: JiraService = Depends(get_jira_service) )
methods.description: Endpoint to get detailed information about a specific Jira project.

methods.name: JiraService get_jira_service()
methods.description: Dependency to instantiate and provide the JiraService.

ctags.name: get_project_details
ctags.signature: ( project_key: str, credentials: JiraCredentials, jira_service: JiraService = Depends(get_jira_service) )
